en.title: Need → first contact
en.caption: Identify the need before choosing a contact.
cards: Clarify: clinical, health promotion, social support, or sanitation?
Urgent medical concern → local health protocol.

fil.title: Tanong → unang kausap
fil.caption: Kilalanin ang pangangailangan bago piliin ang kausap.
cards: Linawin: klinikal, health promotion, tulong panlipunan, o kalinisan?
Agarang usaping medikal → lokal na health protocol.

en.title: Clinical → health team
en.caption: Confirm actual assignments rather than assuming one hierarchy.
cards: Midwife / PHN: technical guidance as assigned locally.

fil.title: Klinikal → health team
fil.caption: Kumpirmahin ang aktuwal na pagtatalaga; huwag magpalagay ng iisang hierarchy.
cards: CHO/MHO: pamunuan ng lokal na health office.
Midwife / PHN: teknikal na gabay ayon sa pagtatalaga.
Klinikal na desisyon: awtorisadong health professional.

en.title: Support → local partner
en.caption: Institutional planning differs from a decision for one person.
cards: Mayor + board: leadership, budget proposal and advice.
BHW president: coordination under local arrangements.

fil.title: Suporta → lokal na katuwang
fil.caption: Iba ang pagpaplano ng institusyon sa pasya para sa isang tao.
cards: Mayor + board: pamumuno, mungkahi at payo sa badyet.
BHW president: koordinasyon ayon sa lokal na kaayusan.
Social welfare: alamin ang posibleng tulong.

en.title: Verify → request
en.caption: Use a locally verified contact and only necessary information.
cards: 1. Explain what you can check; make no promise.
4. Social welfare: possible support, subject to assessment.

fil.title: Tiyakin → hiling
fil.caption: Gumamit ng lokal na na-verify na contact at pinakamaliit na kailangang impormasyon.
cards: 1. Sabihin ang kaya mong tiyakin; huwag mangako.
4. Social welfare: posibleng suporta, ayon sa assessment.

en.title: Reply → follow-up
en.caption: Return to the family with the verified next step.

fil.title: Sagot → follow-up
fil.caption: Balikan ang pamilya sa na-verify na susunod na hakbang.
cards: Ano lang ang may pahintulot na ibahagi?

en.title: Choose → explain
en.caption: Compare the three choices, then explain your first step.

fil.title: Piliin → ipaliwanag
fil.caption: Paghambingin ang tatlong pagpipilian, saka ipaliwanag ang unang hakbang.

scene.en: This fictional scene shows Malou confirming a local contact with a health worker. The blank wall chart is background, not an official organization chart or referral route.
scene.fil: Ipinapakita ng kathang-isip na eksena si Malou na kinukumpirma ang lokal na contact sa health worker. Background ang blangkong chart sa dingding; hindi ito opisyal na organization chart o referral route.
